questions.question: Choose the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: She said that she (have) ________ seen the film before.
Select the correct option to complete the sentence: The report was (write) ________ by Sarah, not by John.
Which sentence correctly reports the instruction given by the teacher? Original: 'You must hand in the assignment by Friday.'
options: The teacher said that we must hand in the assignment by Friday.
The teacher said that we had to hand in the assignment by Friday.
The teacher said that we should hand in the assignment by Friday.
The teacher said that we might hand in the assignment by Friday.
questions.answer: The teacher said that we had to hand in the assignment by Friday.

questions.question: Choose the correct reported speech form: He said, 'I am studying English.'
options: He said that he was studying English.
He said that he is studying English.
He said that he would be studying English.
He said that he has been studying English.
questions.answer: He said that he was studying English.
